description_en: Disassociates a gateway endpoint from route tables by calling the DissociateRouteTablesFromVpcGatewayEndpoint operation
description_zh: 调用DissociateRouteTablesFromVpcGatewayEndpoint接口将网关终端节点与路由表解绑
kebab_example: aliyun vpc dissociate-route-tables-from-vpc-gateway-endpoint --endpoint-id vpce-bp11cwae3p6z7ftbm0000 --route-table-ids vtb-m5elgtm3aj586iitr0000 --client-token TF-DissociateRouteTablesFromVpcGatewayEndpoint-1634369235-8f0000 --dry-run false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DissociateRouteTablesFromVpcGatewayEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The endpoint instance ID of the gateway endpoint
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: performs a dry run.
- **false** (default): sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否检测此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
